## Review checklist

- [ ] The change follows the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/animu-sphere/tessera/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and the active scope in [current work](https://github.com/animu-sphere/tessera/blob/main/docs/roadmap/current.md).

- [ ] Delivered changes are recorded under `## Unreleased` in the changelog, when applicable.
- [ ] New support claims have reproducible evidence in the support matrix.
